## What this stage covers

Writing with an assistant, and then working with an agent: what each is good
for, and where each stops being trustworthy.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
## What you will be able to do

Predict what the code will do before you run it, read the diff rather than the
summary, and write the test that would catch it being wrong.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
## The data you will use

Collisions joined to traffic counts, to compute collision rates.
